findings.claim: The replacement store accepts an incomplete createSurface-only batch instead of refusing it, removing the previous complete-surface validation.
findings.evidence: load() accepts a batch whenever processor.model.getSurface(surfaceId) is non-null and no foreign surfaces remain, then assigns that surface to surface.value. A valid createSurface envelope creates that model without supplying any components. The deleted A2uiEnvelopeValidator.normalizeForGenUi explicitly rejected batches when componentCount == 0, and _validateComponents required a root component. Consequently, an incomplete batch now reaches the renderer without a refusal rather than taking the previous fail-closed path. Constraint A-7 requires preserving existing behavior unless the task requires changing it.
findings.suggested_fix: Before publishing the loaded surface, enforce the application's complete-surface requirement, including the required root component, using the processor's validated model. Refuse and clear incomplete batches rather than treating successful processing of createSurface as a complete renderable surface.
